name: UserCriteria
title: UserCriteria - Scoped
summary: The UserCriteria API provides methods to create, modify, and delete user criteria records using scripts.
overview: To use this class in a scoped application, use the sn_uc namespace identifier. The User Criteria Scoped API plugin (ID: com.glideapp.user_criteria.scoped.api) must be enabled to access this API.

members.name: UserCriteria
members.summary: Creates an instance of the UserCriteria class.

members.name: UserCriteria
members.summary: Creates an instance of the UserCriteria class with the specified sys_id.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
sys_id String sys_id of the user criteria. 
var uc = new sn_uc.UserCriteria("31bea3d53790200044e0bfc8bcbe5dec");

members.name: create
members.summary: Creates a user criteria with specified values in the user_criteria table. Values specified in columnValues override the values provided via setters.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
columnValues Object Key and value pairs for a column and its value.
standardUpdate Boolean Set to true to enable the running of engines and workflow.
Returns
Type Description
String sys_id of the created user criteria. 
var uc = new sn_uc.UserCriteria(); 
uc.setCompanies("31bea3d53790200044e0bfc8bcbe5dec,0c441abbc6112275000025157c651c89");
uc.setActive(true); 
uc.setUsers("31bea3d53790200044e0bfc8bcbe5dec,0c441abbc6112275000025157c651c89");
var UserCriteriaId = uc.create();
gs.info(UserCriteriaId);

Output:

41bea3d53790200044e0bfc8bcbe5dec

members.name: deleteRecord
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
None
Returns
Type Description
Boolean If true, the user criteria is deleted.

If false, no user criteria is found to delete.

 
var uc = new sn_uc.UserCriteria("31bea3d53790200044e0bfc8bcbe5dec");

members.name: read
members.summary: Displays the mapping for the attribute and value pairs of the catalog item.

members.name: setScript
members.summary: Sets the script for the user criteria.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
script String Script to be set for the advanced user criteria.
Returns
Type Description
void 
var uc = new sn_uc.UserCriteria();
uc.setScript("function scriptTest() {
  var retVal;
  if (gs.getUser().getRecord().getDisplayValue('department') == 'Product Management') {
      retVal = true;
  } else {
      retVal = false;
  }
  return retVal;
}");
